checks.name: Dependency advisory audit
checks.purpose: Compare installed dependency advisories with a dated, exact baseline.
checks.concern: Known vulnerable packages or changed advisory exposure.
checks.detectionLimits: An advisory match does not establish reachability or exploitability; the audit covers the installed dependency tree.
checks.falsePositives: An affected package may be unreachable from project inputs.
checks.falseNegatives: Unpublished vulnerabilities and non-package supply-chain risks are not reported.
checks.recommendedAction: Inspect new or changed IDs and installed paths; review remediation compatibility or seek a separate time-limited owner decision.

checks.name: Proposed-commit secret scan
checks.purpose: Scan the pull-request commit range for likely exposed credentials.
evidenceRequired: private administrator triage for any finding
checks.detectionLimits: The PR scan does not prove that every secret, repository ref, or external account is safe.
checks.falsePositives: Test fixtures or revoked tokens may resemble active credentials.
checks.falseNegatives: Unknown formats and secrets outside the scanned range may be missed.
checks.recommendedAction: Triage findings privately; revoke and rotate confirmed exposed credentials without copying values into reports.

checks.name: Security configuration and delivered headers
checks.purpose: Review configured and delivered response protections, including HTTPS and browser headers.
checks.concern: Missing or ineffective headers, unsafe environment separation, or exposed runtime behavior.
evidenceRequired: authorized preview or production response headers
checks.detectionLimits: A header declaration in source does not prove that deployed responses deliver it.
checks.falsePositives: A static inspection may flag a header supplied by the hosting platform.
checks.falseNegatives: A source declaration may hide deployment-specific omissions or path differences.
checks.recommendedAction: Compare source policy with live responses and hosting settings; propose changes separately for owner review.

checks.name: Build and type verification
checks.purpose: Confirm the application still builds and typechecks after proposed security work.
checks.concern: Security changes that break routes, content rendering, or runtime contracts.
evidenceRequired: live CMS integration result when relevant
checks.detectionLimits: A successful fallback-content build does not verify live Sanity access or deployed behavior.
checks.falsePositives: A build may fail because an external content service is temporarily unavailable.
checks.falseNegatives: Compilation can pass while runtime and authorization defects remain.
checks.recommendedAction: Run focused typecheck and build in an authorized environment, recording external-service limitations.

checks.name: Repository and hosting access review
checks.purpose: Confirm actual grants, deployment rights, service accounts, and recovery roles.
checks.concern: Excess privilege or unreviewed production access.
checks.detectionLimits: Repository files cannot establish live account permissions or MFA state.
checks.falsePositives: A documented role may have been removed in the provider account.
checks.falseNegatives: Undocumented provider grants will not appear in source.
checks.recommendedAction: Ask the account owner to review least privilege and offboarding evidence; do not change grants automatically.

checks.name: CMS role and dataset access review
checks.purpose: Verify who can edit, preview, publish, and read CMS content.
checks.concern: Overbroad CMS permissions, public datasets, or weak editor account controls.
checks.detectionLimits: The Studio route and SDK do not reveal live roles, CORS, dataset visibility, or MFA.
checks.falsePositives: A CMS package may remain after the service is retired.
checks.falseNegatives: External CMS accounts or headless publishing may not match source patterns.
checks.recommendedAction: Have the CMS administrator verify live access and document any excess grant for separate approval.

checks.name: CMS content, media, and link review
checks.purpose: Review published text, images, and outbound links for validation and publication controls.
checks.concern: Unsafe links, unauthorized publication, or exposure of identifiable people.
checks.detectionLimits: Schema validation cannot prove that existing live content or third-party destinations are appropriate.
checks.falsePositives: A field allowing links or images may not be used in published content.
checks.falseNegatives: Live content can change without a code change.
checks.recommendedAction: Review representative published content and link destinations with the publisher; record remediation separately.

checks.name: Webhook authentication review
checks.purpose: Verify signature handling, secret scope, and rejection of invalid requests.
checks.concern: Unauthorized cache invalidation or forged provider events.
evidenceRequired: safe valid and invalid signature tests
checks.detectionLimits: A matched signature helper does not prove the live secret is configured or all request paths are protected.
checks.falsePositives: A signature helper can be imported but not used on every path.
checks.falseNegatives: Custom verification helpers may not match inventory patterns.
checks.recommendedAction: Test accepted and rejected requests in a safe environment and confirm provider settings with the owner.

checks.name: Webhook replay and abuse-control review
checks.purpose: Assess retries, duplicate events, request limits, logging, and availability controls.
checks.concern: Valid signed events replayed or sent at harmful volume.
checks.detectionLimits: Signature verification alone does not establish freshness, idempotency, or abuse resistance.
checks.falsePositives: The provider may already enforce controls absent from route source.
checks.falseNegatives: A safe test cannot reproduce every production traffic pattern.
checks.recommendedAction: Review provider delivery behavior and authorized traffic evidence before proposing replay or rate controls.

checks.name: API input and abuse review
checks.purpose: Examine request validation, output handling, method and size limits, and abuse controls.
checks.concern: Untrusted API input or requests causing unintended work.
checks.detectionLimits: Route presence does not identify every input, deployment limit, or threat model.
checks.falsePositives: A route may accept no attacker-controlled body beyond a verified provider event.
checks.falseNegatives: Reverse-proxy or external API behavior is outside repository inspection.
checks.recommendedAction: Review each route's trust boundary and test known invalid requests in a safe environment.

checks.name: Analytics data and privacy review
checks.purpose: Identify actual browser telemetry, identifiers, retention, and notice or consent practices.
checks.concern: Undocumented collection, sharing, or retention of visitor data.
checks.detectionLimits: An analytics import does not show deployed collection, cookies, retention, or legal duties.
checks.falsePositives: A package may be installed while tracking is disabled in production.
checks.falseNegatives: Tag-manager or hosting-side telemetry may not appear in inspected source.
checks.recommendedAction: Compare deployed requests and account settings with the owner's privacy decisions; refer legal questions to qualified review.

checks.name: Visitor authentication and authorization review
checks.purpose: Review role boundaries, session lifecycle, recovery, and access to protected objects.
checks.concern: Account takeover or cross-user access when visitor accounts exist.
checks.detectionLimits: Package or login UI hints do not prove account use or authorization quality.
checks.falsePositives: An unused auth package can remain in a project.
checks.falseNegatives: External login or custom session code may not match inventory patterns.
checks.recommendedAction: If visitor auth is confirmed, define roles and test unauthorized access with owner-approved accounts.

checks.name: Public form validation and privacy review
checks.purpose: Review submissions for validation, abuse prevention, and data handling.
checks.concern: Unsafe input, spam, or unreviewed personal-data collection.
checks.detectionLimits: A form tag does not establish a working public submission flow.
checks.falsePositives: A decorative or client-only form may never transmit data.
checks.falseNegatives: Custom elements or hosted forms can evade source patterns.
checks.recommendedAction: If a public submission flow is confirmed, map fields and handlers before implementing focused tests.

checks.name: Payment flow and PCI scope review
checks.purpose: Map checkout, redirects, tokens, and provider responsibilities before security testing.
checks.concern: Exposure of cardholder data or mistaken payment-control scope.
checks.detectionLimits: SDK presence cannot determine final PCI scope or outsourced-control effectiveness.
checks.falsePositives: A payment package may be unused or test-only.
checks.falseNegatives: Hosted checkout and offline transactions may not appear in source.
checks.recommendedAction: If payments are confirmed, have the owner and payment specialist determine data flow and PCI scope.

checks.name: Application database access and retention review
checks.purpose: Assess grants, backups, encryption, deletion, and retention for a separate application database.
checks.detectionLimits: The inventory database signal excludes Sanity content storage, which is covered by CMS checks.
checks.falsePositives: A database client package may be unused.
checks.falseNegatives: External data stores or custom clients may not match known packages.
checks.recommendedAction: If a separate database is confirmed, ask its administrator to review grants and lifecycle controls.
